capabilities: Move checked tasks to the bottom of their sibling list 5 seconds after checkoff
Carry nested sub-items along with the completed task
Cancel the pending move when a task is unchecked before the timer fires
Skip tasks inside fenced code blocks
extras: No configuration options yet; a settings panel for the 5-second delay is planned. Only [x] and [X] count as completed — custom checkbox states from Dataview or the Tasks plugin are ignored.
problem: Completed tasks stay mixed in with open ones, so users must manually drag finished items to the bottom of their lists.
summary: Task-list helper that moves a checked-off task, with its sub-items, to the bottom of its sibling list 5 seconds later.
